status: Owner-approved final Focus banner: violet Cord, white Wipe. Approved for store submission on 2026-10-17.
creation_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished Chrome Web Store promotional banner for CordWipe, a browser extension that bulk-deletes only the user's own Discord messages. Landscape composition at 1760 x 1120 pixels (exact 11:7 aspect ratio), designed to remain crisp and readable downscaled to 440 x 280. Input image 1 is the APPROVED CordWipe brand mark, not a style suggestion: preserve its integrated purple chat-bubble trash-can silhouette, lid handle, two vertical slots, chat tail at bottom left, black outline and thin white keyline. Reuse that icon as the dominant hero; no redesigned logo, extra symbols inside it, no square background around icon. Dark tech-friendly visual design, professional restrained violet accent palette, large clear typography, few elements, strong hierarchy, spacious margins. Only the explicitly requested text, spelled exactly; no tiny labels, fake app interfaces, fake metrics, certification badges, Chrome or Discord logos, official affiliation claims, extra brand marks or watermark. Full-bleed background.
Composition: confident two-column editorial poster. Left half contains large white brand name "CordWipe", with a smaller but still strongly legible two-line sentence "Delete your own\nDiscord messages". Right half holds the approved icon very large and flat, with a quiet soft violet light behind it. A few restrained message-line shapes recede behind the icon, never competing with it. Deep ink background, crisp typography, minimal polished flat design. Text exactly: "CordWipe" and "Delete your own Discord messages".

Keep the complete text and complete icon comfortably inside a 6% safe margin, icon on the right, copy on left, very legible after reduction to 440 by 280. No extra text, no Discord logo, no badges, no border, no watermark. Output one finished full-bleed banner; do not return a comparison or a framed image. Make the image proportionally taller, not a very wide banner.
